audio.speech: Questions 32 through 34. Listen to the conversation.

Thanks for coming out so quickly. The stain above our reception desk appeared after last night's rain. We are opening a second office next month, so an expensive repair here would be difficult. Let me check the roof before we discuss replacing anything. Sometimes a blocked rain causes water to collect around a perfectly sound roof. The building manager mentioned leaves in the gutters. Can you get upstairs while our clients are arriving? Certainly. I'll use the service staircase, not the lobby. If cleaning the train solves the problem, you won't need a new roof. That's a relief. Please photograph whatever you find. I'll need to show the manager why the work was necessary.
